title: Test task exclusivity declarations
description: Shared-state declarations the check runner reads to schedule plan nodes in parallel (ADR-CHK-0007). The file is `test-task-exclusivity.json` beside `test-tasks.json`, separate from the descriptor so that the descriptor bytes, the descriptor digest, the task-policy digest, and the package-owned evidence verifier stay unchanged (ADR-CHK-0006). `exclusive` names state a node mutates; `shared` names state it only reads. Two declared nodes conflict when either holds exclusively a key the other holds in either list. A descriptor node with no entry here conflicts with every node; an absent file declares no node, so every plan runs one node at a time. An entry naming a node the descriptor does not declare is refused. The file is never an input of a task key, a digest, or a receipt.

nodes.description: Declarations keyed by descriptor nodeId. An empty declaration `{}` holds no key and conflicts only through the implicit rules of ADR-CHK-0007.

key.description: A shared-state key, for example sources, dist, or db.

exclusive.description: State this node mutates. No node that holds any of these keys, in either list, runs at the same time.

shared.description: State this node only reads. It may overlap another node that shares the same key, never one that holds it exclusively.
